rules.authority: Personal Data Protection Act 2010 s.12B(1), (3) as inserted by Act A1727, in force 1 June 2025 (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/3301061_BI/Act%20709%20(Reprint%202026).pdf, read 2026-10-07); Personal Data Protection Commissioner, Guideline on Data Breach Notification paras 6.1, 14.1 (https://www.pdp.gov.my/ppdpv1/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/GP_DBN_ENG.pdf, read 2026-10-07).
rules.when: row.kind == "PERSONAL_DATA_BREACH"

name: Notify affected employees of a personal data breach

rules.description: Where the breach causes or is likely to cause significant harm (facts.significant_harm), notify each affected data subject without unnecessary delay and not later than seven days after the notification to the Commissioner (facts.commissioner_notified_on). Raised when both are recorded on the PERSONAL_DATA_BREACH case.
rules.authority: Personal Data Protection Act 2010 s.12B(2) as inserted by Act A1727 (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/3301061_BI/Act%20709%20(Reprint%202026).pdf, read 2026-10-07); Guideline on Data Breach Notification paras 8.1, 9.1 (https://www.pdp.gov.my/ppdpv1/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/GP_DBN_ENG.pdf, read 2026-10-07).
rules.when: row.kind == "PERSONAL_DATA_BREACH" && has(row.facts) && row.facts != null && has(row.facts.significant_harm) && row.facts.significant_harm == true && has(row.facts.commissioner_notified_on)

name: Inquire into a sexual harassment complaint

rules.description: Inquire into a complaint of sexual harassment in the prescribed manner; or, refusing to inquire (previously inquired and not proven, or frivolous, vexatious or not in good faith), inform the complainant in writing of the refusal and its reasons as soon as practicable and not later than thirty days after receiving the complaint (opened_on). Raised when a SEXUAL_HARASSMENT_COMPLAINT case is opened.
rules.authority: Employment Act 1955 ss.81A, 81B(1)–(3), 81F(a)–(b) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf, read 2026-10-07).
rules.when: row.kind == "SEXUAL_HARASSMENT_COMPLAINT"

name: Inquire when directed by the Director General and report

rules.description: When the Director General directs the employer to inquire into a complaint (on a referral of the employer's refusal, s.81B(5)(a), or a complaint made to the Director General, s.81D(1)), inquire and submit the report of the inquiry within thirty days of the direction (facts.dg_directed_on on the SEXUAL_HARASSMENT_COMPLAINT case).
rules.authority: Employment Act 1955 ss.81B(4)–(5), 81D(1)–(2), 81F(c)–(d) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf, read 2026-10-07).
rules.when: row.kind == "SEXUAL_HARASSMENT_COMPLAINT" && has(row.facts) && row.facts != null && has(row.facts.dg_directed_on)

name: Act on a proven sexual harassment finding

rules.description: Where the employer's inquiry proves sexual harassment (facts.inquiry_outcome PROVEN): against an employee, take disciplinary action (dismissal without notice, downgrading, or a lesser punishment, suspension without wages at most two weeks); against a non-employee, recommend the person be brought before the appropriate disciplinary authority. Raised on the case update recording the finding; due that day.
rules.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.81C(a)–(b) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf, read 2026-10-07).
rules.when: row.kind == "SEXUAL_HARASSMENT_COMPLAINT" && has(row.facts) && row.facts != null && has(row.facts.inquiry_outcome) && row.facts.inquiry_outcome == "PROVEN"

rules.description: Children and Young Persons (Employment) Act 1966 (Act 350), reprint as at 1 December 2011 (Commissioner of Law Revision; copy read 2026-10-08 at https://ccs-co.com/wp-content/uploads/38.-Act-350-Children-and-Young-Persons-Employmen-Act-1966.pdf — jtksm.mohr.gov.my's 2019 reprint, https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-03/5.%20Children%20and%20Young%20Persons%20%28Employment%29%20Act%201966_0.pdf, refused the reader) ss.1A (child: not completed fifteen years; young person: not completed eighteen), 5(1)(a)–(c) and 6(1)(a)–(c): a child not between 8 pm and 7 am, not more than three consecutive hours without thirty minutes' rest, not more than six hours a day (seven with school); a young person not between 8 pm and 6 am, four consecutive hours, seven hours a day (eight with school or as an apprentice). Exceptions (public entertainment under licence; agricultural undertakings and vessels for a young person's night work) are the employer's to confirm, so this warns. The six-days-in-seven limit (s.4) is the WEEKLY_REST_DAY warning's. Peninsular Malaysia only, like this lineage.
